thesis: The site is a borehole: scrolling takes you down through the South Plains ground, and each stratum is one step of how Static Level sits, drills, cases, pumps, and proves a well.

signature.name: borehole-cross-section
signature.summary: Left-edge vertical strata column showing geological layers from surface to water table; each section occupies its true depth band with a blue static-water rule crossed once at the aquifer.

motion.intro: Strata column draws down from surface to 20 ft as hero settles, ≤1.2s
